title: Pass full ip:port to WhoIs instead of IP only
description: In http_auth.go:189, WhoIs is called with only remoteAddr (the IP). The Remote-Port is validated but never included. The official nginx-auth passes addr:port. In userspace networking mode, the port is needed to correctly identify the peer. Should use the already-constructed 'addr' variable (ip:port) instead of just remoteAddr.

title: Make request header logging level configurable
